scope: Python supervisor lifecycle only; tiny owned Python children, no Unity/model inference or GPU acceptance.
problem: Post-spawn receipt errors or interruption could leave the supervisor's root child running.
verification: The exact Popen handle is reaped before final receipt persistence. Original supervision failures remain failures, including KeyboardInterrupt; timeout and natural-exit contracts still pass.
limits: This does not terminate an arbitrary descendant process tree and does not guarantee receipt persistence when the filesystem remains unavailable.
